name: zc_eyes_glow

tests.name: the eyes and the face were both read for every skin at every hour

detail.note: a missing reading means the figure did not project into frame, not that the eyes are dark

tests.name: at noon every skin's eyes out-read the face they are set into

detail.note: local contrast only. The absolute-brightness branch was removed on 2026-09-27: it passed Celestial Light, whose eye is DARKER than its own face at every hour, and Arden Infernal on a clipped head. Daylight is the hard case -- an emissive holds its value while the sunlit stone beside it climbs past.

tests.name: no skin's eyes are proven only by a blown-out head

detail.note: when the exposure clips both the eye and the face, the frame cannot distinguish a lamp from a white square. That is an UNUSABLE sample, not a passing one, and it must be visible.

tests.name: the established eye colour is still readable, not washed to white

detail.note: the founder: preserve each skin's established eye colour, and the customised SECONDARY has to show through the glow. Pure white scores zero separation and carries neither.

tests.name: the eyes read as lit at every hour tested, not only after dark
